hardware: 8 x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition 96GB; compute capability 12.0

experiments.hypothesis: Reproduce MuseTalk 1.5, LatentSync 1.6 and XTTS controls on the same real clips.
experiments.reject_if: Unpinned weights, mixed cache states, missing artifacts, or different workloads invalidate comparison.
experiments.notes: Historical synthetic fixture is a performance reference, not quality evidence. Run fast/quality/dub separately.

experiments.hypothesis: PyNvVideoCodec DLPack surfaces and batched CUDA image operations reduce host copies and preserve one pixel pipeline.
experiments.reject_if: PTS/rotation/range errors, audio drift, worse mouth detail, or no meaningful end-to-end gain.

experiments.hypothesis: Reuse decoded frames and encode once after composition, testing NVENC p4/p6/p7 and CQ16/18/20.
experiments.reject_if: Worse mouth-region detail, invalid timestamps, memory overflow on long clips, or latency above the selected mode budget.

experiments.hypothesis: Emit first audio promptly and compare 160/240/320/500ms chunks without one-chunk lookahead.
experiments.reject_if: Prosody degradation, audible gaps, interrupted speech replay, stale frames, or A/V skew above the agreed gate.
experiments.notes: Measure browser heard-audio timestamps; retain cancellation generation and final-tail semantics.

experiments.hypothesis: Instrument speaker conditioning, then cache reusable conditioning by audio content, model revision and dtype.
experiments.reject_if: No repeated conditioning work exists, cache crosses speakers/models, voice drift, or no end-to-end improvement.

experiments.hypothesis: Fixed-shape torch.compile/CUDA graphs plus bounded batches reduce launch overhead.
experiments.reject_if: Graph churn, long warmup, shape errors, worse p95 under concurrency, or altered output quality.

experiments.hypothesis: Keep conditioning and decoded output on device and compare GPU P2P/IPC or one worker per complete job.
experiments.reject_if: Unsupported topology, unsafe buffer lifetime, higher aggregate VRAM, or lower jobs/hour.
experiments.notes: Measure actual PCIe topology and transfer bytes; do not assume NVLink.

experiments.hypothesis: Compare independent job replicas with 1/2/4 GPU intra-job rendering at equal physical GPU budgets.
experiments.reject_if: Worse latency target or throughput per GPU-hour after accounting for competing workloads.

experiments.hypothesis: Compare seeded latent sampling, posterior mean and stable masks with restoration disabled/enabled independently.
experiments.reject_if: Identity/stubble loss, more flicker, or reduced lip accuracy.
experiments.notes: Posterior mean changes the latent distribution; it is an experiment, not a safe default.

experiments.hypothesis: SoulX-FlashHead Lite can provide responsive image-to-avatar output on one sm_120 GPU.
experiments.reject_if: Cannot install/run natively on sm_120, cannot sustain 25 FPS after warmup, poor identity or unstable chunk boundaries.
experiments.notes: Author 4090 FPS is not a measurement on this host.

experiments.hypothesis: SoulX-FlashHead Pro may improve avatar quality while sustaining playback with two GPUs.
experiments.reject_if: Quality does not beat Lite/MuseTalk enough to justify GPU cost, or latency misses target.

experiments.hypothesis: VoxCPM2 improves expressive multilingual voice cloning with a streaming serving backend.
experiments.reject_if: Number/name errors, voice drift, unsupported language, resampling bugs, or TTFA/RTF regression.
experiments.notes: 2B, 30 languages including Hindi; preserve native 48kHz until an explicit resampling boundary.

experiments.hypothesis: Qwen3-TTS 0.6B and 1.7B Base improve streaming voice cloning and controllability.
experiments.reject_if: No measurable quality/latency advantage, unstable streaming, or required language unsupported.
experiments.notes: Base is the cloning checkpoint; CustomVoice and VoiceDesign are different. Hindi is not listed.

experiments.hypothesis: CosyVoice3 bidirectional text/audio streaming reduces punctuation-dependent delay.
experiments.reject_if: Speech revisions leak to playback, language gaps, quality regression, or no user-perceived TTFA gain.
experiments.notes: Do not apply the README CosyVoice2 TensorRT-LLM speed claim to v3.

experiments.hypothesis: IndexTTS 2.5 speed and phoneme control reduce dubbing duration mismatch and pronunciation errors.
experiments.reject_if: Unacceptable voice/language quality or time stretching remains necessary enough to erase gains.
experiments.notes: duration_factor controls rate, not exact seconds. EN/ZH/JA/ES/AR; custom model use license.

experiments.hypothesis: Qwen3-ASR improves difficult speech, multilingual recognition and short utterances.
experiments.reject_if: Semantic recognition regression or cost outweighs accuracy improvement.
experiments.notes: Streaming vLLM path lacks timestamps/batching; forced aligner language list excludes Hindi.

experiments.hypothesis: Voxtral Mini Realtime causal ASR improves partial transcripts and avatar turn-taking.
experiments.reject_if: Unstable partial text, lower final accuracy, unsupported language, or slow response after endpointing.

experiments.hypothesis: TranslateGemma 12B/27B improve meaning preservation against NLLB and current Qwen translation.
experiments.reject_if: Hallucinated clauses, incorrect numbers/negation, terminology regression, or poor duration-constrained text.
experiments.notes: Use the specialized translation template. Gemma license/access terms apply; fit and KV headroom must be measured.

experiments.hypothesis: The current FA4 CuTe SM120 branch accelerates supported attention shapes in selected models.
experiments.reject_if: Kernel incompatibility, shape coverage gap, numerical error, or no end-to-end gain after compile overhead.
experiments.notes: FA3 Hopper recommendations are not SM120 compatibility evidence.

experiments.hypothesis: SageAttention2 improves supported video attention with acceptable numerical/visual change.
experiments.reject_if: Temporal, lip or identity regression, unsupported head sizes, or minor end-to-end gain.

experiments.hypothesis: FP4 attention may offer additional speed for tolerant video models.
experiments.reject_if: Precision-sensitive output degrades or SM120/model kernels fail.
experiments.notes: Higher risk than Sage2; evaluate only after a BF16/FP16 quality control exists.

experiments.hypothesis: InfiniteTalk with supported LightX2V/FusionX checkpoints improves animated image/video avatars at fewer steps.
experiments.reject_if: Identity/color/camera drift, missing speech, installation failure on CUDA12.8+, or unsustainable playback.
experiments.notes: Not a drop-in LatentSync upgrade; keep image-avatar and faithful webcam-edit scores separate.

experiments.hypothesis: LiveAvatar 14B may deliver higher-quality long-running avatar output using TPP.
experiments.reject_if: PCIe communication prevents real-time output, quality gain is small, or five-GPU cost is unacceptable.
experiments.notes: Published multi-H800 results do not establish performance on this eight-card RTX host. Single-card functionality is a separate test.

experiments.hypothesis: Fish S2 Pro may improve expressive and multilingual speech quality.
experiments.reject_if: License is unsuitable for intended deployment, pronunciation/identity regressions, or serving complexity outweighs benefit.
experiments.notes: Fish Audio Research License: evaluate as research; do not silently promote to production.
